versions.changelog: display name now leads with the capability
Agent onboarding: signup URL, auto-created key, free-credit budget and the 402 top-up path. Attribution links refreshed.

Initial release of aliexpress-product-data.

- Search, browse, and pull AliExpress products with detailed SKU variants and image galleries.
- Read translated buyer reviews with star ratings, reviewer country, per-variant info, and photos.
- Access seller storefront profiles and catalogue listings.
- 6 endpoints; all responses are structured JSON.
- Requires a free Scavio API key.
